verified_apis.observable_result: Loaded local MP4 control reports 2×2 video dimensions and 1-second duration

no_api_findings.finding: Scoped API index review found no built-in MP4 container parser. Buffer and fs read bytes only and do not interpret MP4 boxes or tracks.

limit: Chromium result covers one pinned browser build and the simple H.264/AAC MP4 control. It does not establish every MP4 feature or codec.
